  yieldFraction=0.915  [cold-forming stock yield band 0.85–0.98, midpoint 0.915 — this route makes no flash — deterministic, use verbatim]
  flashAndScaleKg=0  [cold-forming has no impression parting line — it makes no flash; the stock loss is inside the yield band — deterministic, use verbatim]
  forgeId=forge-press-1600t  [F = Kt × σflow × A: moderate shape in aluminium over 288.4 cm² = 809 t (1.2 safety) — deterministic, use verbatim]
  strokesToForm=4  [multi-station cold former: 4 stations, one part every 2 s — deterministic, use verbatim]

  manning=0.5  [cold-forming line crew (forger + heater / handler; open die adds a manipulator) — engineering typical; the screen said 2, headless 1 — deterministic, use verbatim]
  rejectRate=0.02  [2% forging scrap (laps, underfill, cracks at inspection) — engineering typical — deterministic, use verbatim]
  furnaceType=gas  [aluminium forges warm — billets soak in a gas furnace — deterministic, use verbatim]
